title: The Casino Murdoku
specialRules: Only chairs and cars can be occupied. Other icons cannot.
rules: Place everyone on the grid according to their clue to find the murderer. He was in a region alone with the victim.
Only 1 person per row and per column.
"Beside" means in the same room and orthogonally adjacent.
"Directly east" means exactly one cell to the right in the same row.
A corner is where at least 2 walls meet. (The cell must have at least 2 edges drawn)
clues: A (Woman - Adelaide). She was alone. She was in front of a window.
B (Man - Beckett). He was sitting in a chair.
C (Woman - Charlotte). She was directly east of a slot machine, a roulette wheel or a poker table.
D (Woman - Dorothy). She was alone with two men. She was not beside a chair.
E (Man - Eugene). He was in the Payouts room.
F (Woman - Francesca). She was on a carpet. She was north of Dorothy.
G (Man - Gilbert). He was in front of a door. He was either in the Alley or in the Slots room.
H (Man - Hawke). He was with Josephine. He was in front of a window.
I (Man - Ira). He was beside a plant.
J (Woman - Josephine). She was beside a trash can. She was not with Charlotte.
K (Woman - Katherine). There was someone in a car four rows south of her.
L (Woman - Lenora). She was beside a dumpster.
M (Man - Marco). He was in front of a door.
N (Woman - Nadine). She was in front of a window.
O (Man - Otis). He was in a corner.
V (Woman - Violet). The victim. She was alone with the murderer.
